templates.why_chosen: Named in the reference as the architecture-beside-two-result-plots exemplar: the dominant microservice graph sits beside a raw P99 scatter and its smoothed average, using two unrelated colour codes, role at left, method identity at right.
templates.what_to_learn: Give the dominant architecture panel over half the figure's area and let the two result plots (raw and smoothed) sit as clearly smaller subordinate panels; keep separate colour codes for structural role versus method identity fully apart, since sharing one figure without a divider (a listed weakness) risks a reader reading the wrong key.
